sources.ref: TANCHJIM Android app 2.5.7.4 (com.tanchjim.android): Space2Command, DecodingEarAmplifierFragment, MicrophoneGainSetActivity

meta.notes: Space II, Space Pro and Space Pro AT: the app gives them 10 bands and the same DAC screen, driven with the handler's control commands: DAC filter (0x11), gain (0x19), DAC mode (0x1D; 0 is class AB here, where NICEHCK's PureAural has 0 as class H), volume 0 to 100 (0x85), microphone gain -15 to +15 dB in whole dB (0x02, s16 ×256 with the whole dB in the high byte) and balance (0x16, one channel cut by up to 127 dB, the other at 0). The app follows a volume write with [1,0x04]; the handler doesn't. Whether the firmware rounds the microphone gain onto a coarser grid, as the CrinEar Protocol Micro does (1.5 dB), is unknown. Not a control yet: DRE (0x32, one byte, 0 on and 1 off), which the app shows on these three models.
